event_text: DWP posts a notice on GOV.UK saying it has taken some online services offline as a precaution after identifying a cyber incident affecting its systems
notes: Time is the notice's publication time on GOV.UK.

event_text: Online systems for pensions, Universal Credit and PIP applications, and the Tell Us Once service, cannot be accessed, the BBC reports
The online systems for pensions, Universal Credit and PIP applications, and Tell Us Once, still cannot be accessed, the BBC reports
